description: Active Transportation Counter Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Observations from active transportation traffic counters. - Each sensor's flow definitions and locations details. - Public dashboard Note: This is raw and uncleaned data. Some records may be inaccurate counts due to sensor issues. Coverage: Austin. The table has 8 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
